mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.wedding_fund AS wedding_fund FROM `user` u WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.id IN ( SELECT #{userId} UNION SELECT CASE WHEN c.groom_id = #{userId} THEN c.bride_id ELSE c.groom_id END FROM couple c WHERE c.status = 'CONNECTED' AND (c.groom_id = #{userId} OR c.bride_id = #{userId}) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.id = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
